title: eval-activation-webhooks-and-sampling-policies-for-pin-events
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: When teams pin a model version in the catalog or a customer pins a model on a private deployment, we currently have ad-hoc eval triggers (manual runs or heavyweight preflight only). This leads to gaps: slow detection of regressions, noisy full-eval runs for low-risk changes, and lack of consistent prioritization across catalog vs customer-locked cases.

Goal: Implement an automated, scalable eval activation mechanism that triggers appropriate evaluation workloads when model versions or serving-relevant configs are pinned/upgraded. The mechanism should use signed webhooks + internal event bus, support configurable sampling policies (lightweight smoke vs full regression), enforce rate limits and priority queues (catalog vs customer-pinned), and surface results to Console and the rollout engine for canaries/auto-rollbacks.

Scope: Catalog model pins and customer-pinned model version changes (both hosted and Dedicated/Private control plane events). Exclude: user-initiated ad-hoc evals, retrospective evaluation of historical pins (future work).

Design summary: 1) Pin Change Producer: when a pin/upgrade happens, the control plane emits a PinChange event with metadata (model id, pinned_version, config diff, owner, environment). 2) Webhook + Signature: a thin webhook endpoint receives pin events and enqueues them to EvalActivations service after verifying signature. 3) Sampling Policy Engine: based on policy rules (project-level override, catalog criticality, customer tier, change size), decide between: a lightweight smoke eval (fast, 30s, small sample), a targeted canary eval (medium cost), or a full regression suite (high cost). 4) Priority Fanout + Rate Limiting: customer-pinned events have higher queue priority and reserved capacity; catalog-only non-production pins use best-effort queue. 5) Eval Runner Orchestration: schedule runs with tags to indicate trigger source, store results and delta metrics in EvalResults store. 6) Console & Rollout Integration: surface pass/fail/signal and delta metrics on the pin detail page; wire auto-block/rollback signals into rollout engine if regression exceeds thresholds.

Key design trade-offs: - Smoke evals reduce cost and surface obvious regressions quickly but can miss subtle regressions. We'll conservatively surface smoke results as advisory and require stronger signals for auto-rollback. - Prioritization must balance fairness vs reserved capacity; implement soft quotas first, move to strict reservations if we see starvation. - Webhook signing simplifies integration with private control planes but requires sync for key rollout; include rotation plan in ops doc.

Metrics to track: time-to-first-eval, percent of pins with smoke eval within 5m, full-eval completion latency, false-positive rate for smoke-driven alerts, cost per pin event, number of auto-rollbacks triggered and their precision.

Telemetry & audits: every activation must be auditable (who pinned, policy applied, sample size, result summary) to comply with enterprise audit needs.
acceptance_criteria: PinChange events for both catalog and customer-locked pins are emitted to EvalActivations with signed webhook validation
Sampling policy rules exist and are configurable in Console (SMOKE, TARGETED_CANARY, FULL)
EvalActivations enqueues jobs into priority queues and honors rate limits in staging
Smoke eval runs complete for >90% of test pins in under 5 minutes in staging
Eval results (delta metrics and verdicts) appear on the pin detail page and include a raw artifact link
Rollout engine can consume the eval verdict and block a pinned upgrade when thresholds exceeded (configurable toggle)
tasks: Write PRD with event schema and sampling policy examples (owner: PM)
Add webhook signing + verification to control plane and Private agent (eng)
Implement EvalActivations service: enqueue, policy decision, routing (eng)
Add priority queueing + soft reservation in runner (infra/eng)
Create smoke eval harness (small prompt set, fast metrics) and CI job (research/eng)
Console UI: sampling policy editor and pin-event detail view (frontend)
Integrate rollout engine hook for auto-block signals (eng + product)
Docs & runbook: key rotation, troubleshooting, opt-out (docs/support)
risks: Smoke eval false negatives may create false confidence — mitigate by conservative thresholds and human review for critical pins
Bursting pin events (e.g., catalog-wide model refresh) could overload eval runners — mitigate with rate limits and backoff
Private deployments need a secure channel for webhook keys; rollout key rotation carefully to avoid failures
outcome_success_criteria: Reduce median detection time for regressions after pins from days to <30 minutes
>75% of customer-pinned upgrades have at least a smoke eval within 5 minutes
No more than 5% of auto-rollbacks are unwarranted (precision target)
Product and SRE report lower manual eval burden after launch
